injectItemsSchema.description: Raw Responses API items to append to the thread's model-visible history.

lastTurnIdSchema.description:
Optional last turn id to fork through, inclusive.

When specified, turns after `last_turn_id` are omitted from the fork. The referenced turn cannot be in progress.

boundary: 类型差集不是实际故障计数；other 为协议兜底变体。
